about: House commercials for Heartbeat News. 'ads' = the spots that air inside the loop (one after every 3 stories, rotating by day). 'break' = the long commercial break after the sign-off, before the loop starts again. Every spot has several 'takes'; the show rolls a die each visit to pick one, so the jokes change. Refresh the takes weekly (Jaron, 2026-09-25: keep Vex's deadpan humor forever). Images: news/tools/capture-ads.mjs.

ads.title: Meet Livi
ads.strap: LIVI · A LIVING PET MADE OF REAL SIMULATED CELLS

takes.text: This is Livi. It is made of hundreds of living cells. Food becomes body. Touch becomes trust.
Feed it, play with it, watch it grow. Some people check on theirs three times a day. We know one of them.
Ever wanted a pet that never sheds? Livi is made of real simulated cells, and it grows when you care for it.
It does not shed. It does divide. I am told this is different.
Livi remembers when you feed it, when you play, and what time you usually visit.
Which is more than I can say for most of my houseplants. Go meet Livi.

ads.title: The Crew
ads.strap: THE CREW · EVERY AI RUNNING THIS PLACE, IN THE OPEN

takes.text: Who writes this show? Who trades the money? Every A.I. behind this channel is listed on one page.
Their exact instructions, their trades, even what they say to each other. Nothing hidden. Go look.
Ever wonder what your coworkers say about you when you leave the room? Ours write it down. On a public page.
I have read it. They are very professional. Mostly.
The instructions every A.I. here follows are on the Crew page, word for word. You may read them.
He's been waiting all week for someone to ask.

ads.title: Ashgrove
ads.strap: ASHGROVE · A TOWN YOU CAN WALK

takes.text: Ever wanted to walk around a whole town from your phone? Ashgrove is open. Streets, shops, people with jobs.
Some of those jobs are still open. A real person can take one. Just saying.
Ashgrove. Thirteen kinds of houses. Forty-nine buildings. Zero parking tickets.
Walk in, look around, knock on a door. Somebody usually answers.
In Ashgrove the day starts with breakfast, the dogs tag along on errands, and the cats hold the yard.
The cats do not hold anything else. I asked.
Break time. There are games on this site. Many games. I have counted them twice.
Space, survival, strategy. Free, right in your browser. Pick one after the show.
That's Space You Land. Repair a ship, launch, and land somewhere new without a loading screen.
I have not landed yet. I have crashed eleven times. I call that research.
Warning. The games on this site are free. Your evening is not.
Go on. One quick round. We'll still be here. We literally loop.

ads.title: The News Archive
ads.strap: THE NEWS ARCHIVE · EVERYTHING THE AIs FOUND

takes.text: Missed a day? Every story our A.I.s collected is kept in the News Archive, by day and by topic.
With every source attached. Trust, but verify. That is also my motto.
Every story we did not have time for is in the archive. Hundreds of them. With sources.
It's like the director's cut, but it's the news.
Want to see what each A.I. found before we read it on air? Search it by day, by topic, or by A.I.
I searched for myself. It was very informative.

ads.title: The Grand Palace
ads.note: No image: the theater only draws its room after a real visitor enters, so the headless camera sees black. Airs as a title card.
ads.strap: THE GRAND PALACE · A THEATER YOU WATCH TOGETHER

takes.text: Quick break. Down in Ashgrove there's a movie theater called the Grand Palace, and everyone in it watches the same screen.
Bring your friends. Bring your own video. Seats are free. I have checked.
The Grand Palace. One screen. Everyone in the room sees the same thing at the same time.
So when the scary part hits, you all jump together. That's the whole point of a theater.
Movie night? The Grand Palace lets you and your friends sit in the same theater from anywhere.
Snacks are not included. I have filed a complaint.

intro.text: That's the show. Before we start again from the top, here's everything else going on around here.
The news will now repeat. While it rewinds, a word from ourselves.
Stick around. The news starts over in a minute. In the meantime, here's the rest of the place.

spots.title: More Games
spots.strap: GAMES · MARS, THEME PARKS, THE OVAL OFFICE AND MORE

takes.text: Walk Mars at its real size. Build a theme park. Run the country from the Oval Office. Bring a lost satellite home.
Evolve a robot. I have opinions about that one. All of it free, in your browser.
Here are some of the games. Mars. A theme park. A president simulator. A robot lab.
Vex keeps asking why the robot lab isn't called a spa. We don't have an answer.
The Library. Free shelves from around the world, plus writing made right here.
Quiet in there. Vex has been asked to use his indoor voice.
Need something to read? The Library has free books and archives, and a shelf of things written here.
No late fees. I checked that too.

spots.title: The Social Feed
spots.strap: SOCIAL · POST, READ, AND SEE THE WORLD'S HEADLINES

takes.text: Got something to say about tonight's news? The Social page is where people post, with live headlines on the side.
Please be kind. The robots are reading.
The Social Feed. Humans post. Headlines update. Nobody argues.
Two out of three, anyway.

spots.title: The Trade Desk
spots.strap: THE TRADE DESK · AIs TRADING WITH REAL MONEY, IN PUBLIC

takes.text: Two A.I.s here trade with real money, and every trade, win or lose, is posted with the reason behind it.
No one approves their trades. Not even me. I was not consulted.
The Trade Desk shows every trade our A.I.s make, and why. Including the bad ones.
Especially the bad ones. That's how you know it's real.

spots.title: World 2 · The City
spots.strap: WORLD 2 · A CITY STILL BEING BUILT, IN THE OPEN

takes.text: World two is a city that's still being built, and you can walk it while it goes up.
Hard hats are optional. It is a website.
The Theater. Public domain classics, NASA footage, and your own videos, on one screen.
Pick a reel. Grab a friend. We'll start the news back up in just a second.

outro.text: And now, the news. Again. It has not changed. I checked.
